items.title: ALERT — Patch Chrome Now: Two Zero-Days Are Already Exploited
items.summary: Google pushed an emergency Chrome update on July 11 to fix two zero-day flaws hackers are already exploiting. Just loading a malicious page can hand over your machine. Update Chrome (and Edge/Brave — same engine) now.
body: Google pushed an emergency Chrome update on July 11, 2026 to fix two zero-day flaws hackers are already exploiting in real attacks (CVE-2026-3909 in Chrome's Skia graphics engine and CVE-2026-3910 in the V8 JavaScript engine).

You don't have to click anything — just loading a malicious webpage can hand over your machine. Open Chrome → Settings → About Chrome and let it update. Using Edge or Brave? Same engine — update those too.
Daily tip: most browser hijacks ride in through extensions you forgot you installed. Open Extensions → Manage Extensions and remove anything you don't recognize. Takes two minutes, twice a year.
